title: Curated knowledge
description: The front matter of a curated knowledge record under .ai/repo/knowledge/curated/: one durable statement this repository holds about itself, what class of statement it is, how it is known, how far it has been confirmed, and what it was derived from. Memory is not a second store: a fact worth carrying into the next session's context is this record with class `memory`. The body carries the statement and, where it helps, the evidence in prose.

schema.description: The format version of this record. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The identity, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It fixes the file name and survives a retitle.

class.description: fact: something true of this repository now. convention: how it is done here. constraint: something outside the repository that limits it. memory: a fact worth carrying into the next session's context, which `context` may draw on. lesson: what an earlier attempt cost.

title.description: The statement itself, in one line, as an assertion rather than a topic.

description.description: One line saying what the statement is for or when it applies.

status.description: candidate: written, not confirmed; machine extraction produces this and nothing else. verified: confirmed against evidence that provenance.derived_from names. superseded: replaced by the record named in superseded_by.

epistemics.description: How the statement is known. observed: read off the repository or a command's output. inferred: concluded, not read. decided: it is true because a decision made it true, and relations names that decision.

date.description: The day the record reached its current status, YYYY-MM-DD.

superseded_by.description: The record that replaced this one. Present exactly when the status is superseded.

provenance.description: Where the statement came from. Required for `verified`: nothing is confirmed by having been written down.

origin.description: authored: a person wrote it. extracted: `majordomus knowledge propose` derived it from a local record, which derived_from names.

derived_from.description: Typed references to the evidence: `decision:<task-id>`, `session:<id>`, `commit:<sha>`, `issue:<id>`, `file:<repository-relative path>`, `test:<repository-relative path>`. A file or test reference must resolve.

relations.description: Typed links to other records of this layer. A target that looks like an identity of this layer must resolve.
